responsibility: Owns the structured execution contract, records the canonical accepted authority an ALLOW rests on, and verifies that its binding recomputes from authority.
mutation_interface: AuthorizationAuthority.record through AuthorityStore.insert, with the binding hash computed at write time
failure_boundary: fail_closed — verify refuses an unknown authorization, a binding that does not recompute, a verdict that is not ALLOW, a superseded objective and a moved baseline, and raises rather than returning a soft result
recovery_behavior: Verification is a pure re-derivation from stored rows, so it yields the same verdict after any crash, restart or process change without needing cached state
replacement_contract: A replacement must bind instruction hash, decision hash, authorization identity, scope and baseline into one recomputable digest, must carry required_evidence naming canonical accepted authority rather than retrieved antecedent ids, and must refuse on mutation, non-ALLOW verdict, stale objective or moved baseline
evidence_produced: reason_code from a closed vocabulary per verdict
BindingError or StaleAuthorization detail naming recorded versus recomputed
